incoming.name: Brussels
incoming.excerpt: The commuter services operated by De Lijn, TEC and SNCB/NMBS will in the next few years be augmented by an RER rail network around Brussels.

incoming.name: Paris
incoming.excerpt: As such, an additional express network, known as the RER, has been created since the 1960s to connect more distant parts of the conurbation.

outgoing.name: Paris
outgoing.excerpt: The RER (Réseau Express Régional, IPA /ɛʀøɛʀ/, "Regional Express Network") is an urban rail network in the Île-de-France région, notably Paris and its agglomeration.
